courthouses.name: Visalia (County Civic Center)
courthouses.note: Cases served per court: Criminal, Traffic, Domestic Violence, Civil, Family, Probate, Mental Health, Appeals, CARE Court and more. Criminal/traffic payments at Room 124. Public Defender's Visalia office is in this building (Room G-35). Self-Help at this courthouse: 559-737-5500, selfhelp@tulare.courts.ca.gov (in person Mon–Thu 8–4, Fri 8–12).

courthouses.name: Porterville (South County Justice Center)
courthouses.hours: Building Mon–Fri 8:00 a.m.–4:00 p.m.; outside windows 8–4 for limited services
courthouses.note: Cases served per court: Criminal, Traffic, Domestic Violence, Civil, Family Law, Restraining Orders, CARE Court. Self-Help at this courthouse: 559-737-5500, selfhelp@tulare.courts.ca.gov (in person Mon–Thu 8–4, Fri 8–12).

courthouses.name: Dinuba Division
courthouses.hours: Mon and Wed–Thu 8:00 a.m.–4:00 p.m.; closed Tuesday and Friday
courthouses.note: Cases served per court: Criminal, Traffic, Family Law; DCSS (child support) matters heard Mon, Wed, Thu. Criminal/traffic payments accepted Wednesdays 8:00 a.m.–12:00 p.m.

courthouses.name: Pretrial Facility (in-custody court)
courthouses.hours: Closed to the public — all hearings held remotely; phone Mon–Fri 8:00 a.m.–4:00 p.m.
courthouses.note: Court lists 'Last day arraignments, In custody hearings' here, and references South County Justice Center – Porterville (Dept. 16). Contact the court about the in-custody calendar. Located at the Sheriff's Pre-Trial Facility complex (inferred from name; not stated by the Sheriff).

courthouses.name: Juvenile Justice Facility
courthouses.note: Juvenile delinquency and dependency only — not adult criminal.

jails.name: Adult Pre-Trial Facility
jails.address: 36650 Road 112 (court's address for the Pretrial Facility courtroom)
jails.phone_note: Number is the Sheriff's facility contact for the Pre-Trial Facility lieutenant. Internet video visits Sun–Sat 7:45–11:05 a.m., 1:00–4:10 p.m., 8:00–9:20 p.m. (scheduled online). Deposits through Access Corrections (accesscorrections.com or lobby kiosk; account login now required).
jails.court_ids_note: The court holds in-custody hearings and last-day arraignments at its Pretrial Facility courtroom; Visalia is the main criminal courthouse. Not confirmed per person.
jails.todo: Sheriff's pages give no street address or men/women housing; address is the court's Pretrial Facility location

bail.note: Before paying a bail agent, check that their license is active using the California Department of Insurance license lookup (search by name or license number). Tulare Superior Court's criminal page explains bail and own-recognizance release at arraignment; a bail schedule link was not found on the court's Criminal page. Inmate account deposits go through Access Corrections (the Sheriff noted a system update pausing deposits until 9/20). This is information only, not legal advice.
